Anne from{NEWLINE}Vermilion Harbor back to Olivine Harbor.{SCROLL}A train and a cruise ship!{NEWLINE}This trip is going to be so much fun!

strings.zh: 哇！你是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}自从你在圣安努号上救了我们之后,{CLEAR}我就一直在关注你。{CLEAR}后来听说你又在金黄市赶跑了火箭队、{CLEAR}在石英大会上赢得了联盟冠军的称号,{CLEAR}还在华蓝洞穴彻底击败了{CLEAR}火箭队的首领坂木！{SCROLL}哎呀,光顾着说了,{NEWLINE}这个是我为你准备的谢礼,{CLEAR}本来想着寄到真新镇去的,{CLEAR}没想到你竟然直接来我家了,{CLEAR}那就在这里送给你吧！

Anne, I’ve been following your{CLEAR}every move.{SCROLL}Later I heard you drove Team{NEWLINE}Rocket out of Saffron City,{CLEAR}won the League Champion title at the{CLEAR}Indigo Conference, and even crushed{CLEAR}Team Rocket’s boss Giovanni for good{CLEAR}in Cerulean Cave!{SCROLL}Oh, listen to me go on. This is a{NEWLINE}thank-you gift I got ready for you.{SCROLL}I was going to mail it to Pallet Town,{NEWLINE}but I never thought you’d{CLEAR}come to my house in person!{CLEAR}So let me give it to you right here!

strings.zh: 你居然能把火箭队那帮暴徒给打败,{NEWLINE}真是太厉害了！

strings.zh: 不管三圣兽是以什么方式重现于世的,{NEWLINE}它们终究是离开封印{CLEAR}回到了这个世界。{CLEAR}按照古代传说,{CLEAR}巨大的危险和凤王的回归{CLEAR}可能也就近在眼前了。
strings.en: However the three legendary{NEWLINE}beasts came back into the world,{CLEAR}they have left their seal and returned.{SCROLL}According to the ancient legends,{NEWLINE}a great danger, and Ho-Oh’s return,{CLEAR}may be close at hand.

strings.zh: 我听那边的小姑娘说,{NEWLINE}在烧焦塔的封印被解除之前,{CLEAR}炎帝就曾经出现在阿里鲁夫遗迹。{CLEAR}根据炎帝的说法是{CLEAR}未知图腾把它带出的封印。{SCROLL}但是我觉得事情不会那么简单,{NEWLINE}未知图腾不该有这么强的力量,{CLEAR}这股力量能够穿透凤王的封印{CLEAR}直接带出炎帝,{CLEAR}说明这股力量的主人{CLEAR}甚至比凤王还要强大。

According to Entei, it was the{CLEAR}Unown who brought it out of the seal.{SCROLL}But I don’t think it’s that simple. The{NEWLINE}Unown shouldn’t have that much power.{SCROLL}A power strong enough to pierce{NEWLINE}Ho-Oh’s seal and pull Entei straight{CLEAR}out means whoever wields it may be even{CLEAR}stronger than Ho-Oh.

strings.zh: 你好,我曾经是阿鲁夫遗迹的研究员,{NEWLINE}现在在圆珠市这里{CLEAR}研究关于凤王和三圣兽的传说。{SCROLL}你如果去过阿鲁夫遗迹,{NEWLINE}应该听说过口袋妖怪考古界的权威{CLEAR}秀力博士的大名吧。{CLEAR}秀力博士致力于对古代传说、{CLEAR}古代精灵的研究,{CLEAR}我从他那里学到过不少东西。{SCROLL}但是最近我听说秀力博士失踪了,{NEWLINE}如果是有人想拿他的研究成果做坏事{CLEAR}而把他给劫持了,{CLEAR}那后果真是不堪设想。
strings.en: Hello. I used to be a researcher at the{NEWLINE}Ruins of Alph. Now I’m here in Ecruteak{CLEAR}City, studying the legends of Ho-Oh and{CLEAR}the three legendary beasts.{SCROLL}If you’ve been to the Ruins of Alph,{NEWLINE}you must have heard of Prof. Hale,{CLEAR}an authority on Pokémon archaeology.{SCROLL}Prof. Hale has devoted himself to{NEWLINE}ancient legends and ancient Pokémon.{CLEAR}I learned a lot from him.{SCROLL}But lately I’ve heard Prof. Hale has{NEWLINE}gone missing.{SCROLL}If someone kidnapped him to use his{NEWLINE}research for evil, the consequences{CLEAR}don’t bear thinking about.

strings.zh: 是一本研究笔记,要读读看吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: It’s a research notebook. Read it?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 据说凤王回归的时候,{NEWLINE}就是人们遇到危险的时候。{CLEAR}这时凤王会选择德才兼备的训练家{CLEAR}与它一起并肩作战。{CLEAR}这是不是意味着{CLEAR}作为凤王护卫的三圣兽,{CLEAR}也会选择他们认可的训练家{CLEAR}与之一起并肩作战呢？

Could you tell me some stories{CLEAR}from your journey?{SCROLL}Since I can’t go out, I’m really curious{NEWLINE}about the world outside.

strings.en: If you ever have time, you’re welcome{NEWLINE}to come and tell me more about{CLEAR}your adventures.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『关东地区金黄市的{NEWLINE}道馆馆主娜姿小姐,{CLEAR}她是天生具有超能力的女孩,{CLEAR}她有一次直接用超能力{CLEAR}把我传送进了她制作的异空间,{CLEAR}她甚至还在异空间里创造了一个自己！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sabrina, the Gym Leader of{NEWLINE}Saffron City in Kanto, is a girl born with{CLEAR}psychic powers.{SCROLL}Once she used them to teleport me{NEWLINE}straight into a pocket dimension she{CLEAR}made, and she even created another{CLEAR}copy of herself inside it!

strings.zh: 世上还有这样的人吗！{NEWLINE}居然能自己创造空间,{CLEAR}还能把人给转移？！{CLEAR}听起来像是很多口袋妖怪{CLEAR}都无法做到的事情啊。{SCROLL}果然世界是很大的,{NEWLINE}如果不是亲自去旅行,{CLEAR}很难有这样奇妙的见闻。
strings.en: There are people like that in this{NEWLINE}world?! She can make her own{CLEAR}dimension and move people into it?!{CLEAR}That sounds like something even most{CLEAR}Pokémon can’t do.{SCROLL}The world really is a big place.{NEWLINE}If you don’t travel yourself,{CLEAR}it’s hard to come across such wonders.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我有一次受了很重的伤,{NEWLINE}被告知要去白银山养伤,{CLEAR}结果那里正好有一个温泉,{CLEAR}我就去泡了好多次温泉。{CLEAR}虽然白银山白雪飘飘,{CLEAR}但是那里的温泉却很暖和。{CLEAR}根据娜姿小姐的说法,{CLEAR}也是多亏了温泉的疗效,{CLEAR}我的伤才能这么快痊愈。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Once, I was badly hurt{NEWLINE}and told to recover at Mt. Silver.{CLEAR}There happened to be a hot spring{CLEAR}there, so I soaked in it lots of times.{SCROLL}Mt. Silver may be covered in snow,{NEWLINE}but its hot spring is really warm.{CLEAR}Sabrina says it was thanks to the{CLEAR}spring’s healing powers that my wounds{CLEAR}healed so fast.

strings.zh: 白银山吗……那可是整个地区的圣山,{NEWLINE}据说有很多强大的精灵栖息在那里。{CLEAR}像我们这些普通人可能一辈子{CLEAR}都没有机会进入白银山。{SCROLL}精灵联盟能批准你进去,{NEWLINE}看来你是非常厉害的训练家啊！
strings.en: Mt. Silver... That’s the sacred{NEWLINE}mountain of the whole region. They say{CLEAR}lots of powerful Pokémon live there.{SCROLL}Ordinary people like us may never get{NEWLINE}the chance to set foot on Mt. Silver in{CLEAR}our whole lives.{SCROLL}If the Pokémon League let you in,{NEWLINE}you must be an amazing Trainer!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我在旅行的途中{NEWLINE}也遭遇过好多次火箭队,{CLEAR}幸好有我的朋友和我的精灵们帮助,{CLEAR}才能一次次地打退他们,{CLEAR}一次次粉碎他们的阴谋。{CLEAR}后来我还在常磐道馆和华蓝洞穴{CLEAR}打败了火箭队的首领坂木。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’ve run into Team Rocket{NEWLINE}plenty of times on my journey.{CLEAR}Luckily, with help from my friends and{CLEAR}my Pokémon, I drove them back again and{CLEAR}again and crushed every scheme.{SCROLL}Later, I even defeated Team Rocket’s{NEWLINE}boss, Giovanni, at the Viridian Gym and{CLEAR}in Cerulean Cave.

strings.zh: 啊！你、你是击败火箭队的英雄——{NEWLINE}联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{SCROLL}真是抱歉刚才都没有认出来,{NEWLINE}我明明买了很多印着你照片的明信片,{CLEAR}看到真人却没能一眼认出来,{CLEAR}哎呀,真是太丢脸了。
strings.en: Ah! Y-you’re the hero who defeated{NEWLINE}Team Rocket, League Champion {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}I’m so sorry I didn’t recognize you.{NEWLINE}I’ve bought loads of postcards{CLEAR}with your photo on them,{CLEAR}and I still didn’t know you in person.{CLEAR}Oh, how embarrassing.

strings.zh: 谢谢你帮我们击退了火箭队,{NEWLINE}关东地区、城都地区才能重回和平安定。{CLEAR}我,我……呜呜呜……谢谢你……
strings.en: Thank you for driving back Team Rocket{NEWLINE}for us. Kanto and Johto are peaceful{CLEAR}and stable again because of you.{SCROLL}I, I... *sob*... Thank you...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不用客气,{NEWLINE}这都是我应该做的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You’re welcome.{NEWLINE}I was only doing what I should.

strings.zh: 我以前也是一名训练家,{NEWLINE}小波波的母亲比雕{CLEAR}就是跟我并肩作战的精灵,{CLEAR}但是它也在那场火箭队动乱中{CLEAR}永远地离开了我……{SCROLL}这个是我以前给比雕带的道具,{NEWLINE}送给你吧,{CLEAR}希望你能带着它继续披荆斩棘,{CLEAR}让正义的光芒照亮每一个角落。
strings.en: I used to be a Trainer too.{NEWLINE}My little Pidgey’s mother, Pidgeot,{CLEAR}was the Pokémon who fought by my side.{SCROLL}But she, too, left me forever in that{NEWLINE}Team Rocket uprising...{SCROLL}This is the item my Pidgeot used to hold.{NEWLINE}I want you to have it.{SCROLL}I hope you’ll carry it with you{NEWLINE}as you keep blazing your trail,{CLEAR}and let the light of justice shine into{CLEAR}every corner.

strings.zh: 谢谢你,冠军大人。{NEWLINE}能跟你聊天我真的非常开心。
strings.en: Thank you, Champion. I’m so glad I got{NEWLINE}to talk with you.
